remarks:
Welcome to this charming Bemus Point cottage offering an inviting and comfortable getaway in the heart of the Chautauqua Lake area. This cozy two-bedroom, two-bath home  With its convenient one-level layout, this cottage offers easy living and the perfect opportunity to enjoy all that the Bemus Point area has to offer.

The home features a comfortable living room and five total rooms, with two bedrooms located on the first floor. A refrigerator is included, and the property offers vinyl and some flooring throughout. The cottage is equipped with a window air-conditioning unit and space heating, with electric and gas utilities. 


Outside, the property includes a detached shed, providing useful storage for outdoor equipment, recreational gear, and seasonal items.


, this property puts you close to the attractions and recreation of the Chautauqua Lake region. Whether you're looking for a seasonal cottage, a weekend retreat, the ability to Airbnb or a place to enjoy the area year-round, this property offers a great opportunity to create your own getaway in a desirable lake-community setting.

Come enjoy the relaxed pace and charm of Bemus Point and make this cottage your own! Property is being sold in its current condition. Schedule your showing today.
